feature: Spirit-box-origin answers, retained physical ghost audio, and replacement static
radio_origin: Replies attach to the local replicated spirit box and follow placement/carrying; ghost movement does not move the reply.
ghost_origin: MallGhostAudio preserves independent eye-height positional playback attached to the ghost, currently used by its existing signal chime. No new automatic chase/scare behavior.
static_import_recovery: Import+overwrite of the native-rooted original triggered Unreal !IsRooted; imported a fresh asset instead. Original SoundWave preserved. Native defaults and Blueprint use the new asset.
static_format: Original deterministic 12-second seamless mono 48000 Hz PCM16 filtered noise; no third-party broadcasts or voices; zero clipped samples.
response_bindings: where_are_you, who_are_you, how_old_are_you remain separate editable sound/subtitle entries, sharing the authorized temporary voice WAV.
environmental_acoustics: Map-specific reverb, reflections and occlusion remain deferred.
manual_test: Final perceived static quality, loudness and spatial direction remain a user listening test. No microphone accessed by automation.
